title: Gryllus campestris 02 (HS)
author: Harald Süpfle
changes: Real recording of a European field cricket (Gryllus campestris) chirping, used for the cave cricket (cave crickets have no wings and cannot chirp). Trimmed to 3.62–5.30 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
